candidate.definition_en: In an unwilling and hesitant way.
candidate.explanation_ar: لما تعمل حاجة وإنت مش عايز تعملها، بتعملها بتقل وبدون نفس.

senses.definition_en: In an unwilling and hesitant way.
senses.definition_ar: على مضض، بتردد وبدون رغبة حقيقية.

examples: I reluctantly agreed to help him.
The government reluctantly admitted its mistake.
He reluctantly relinquished control of the company he founded.
candidate.mnemonic: 'Reluctant' قريبة من 'Lock'.. كأنك 'Locked' ومجبر تعمل الحاجة فبتعملها 'Reluctantly'.
